latestVersion.changelog: This skill enables playing a rhythm game called "节奏大师" (Rhythm Master) similar to QQ Dance/DDR. Players press arrow keys and spacebar in time with falling notes to score points. The game features multiple difficulty levels, combo system, judgment ratings (PERFECT/GREAT/GOOD/BAD/MISS), local leaderboard, and can be extended with online leaderboards. Use this skill when the user wants to play a rhythm game, test their reflexes, or have fun with a keyboard-based music game.
